geometry: row-L2-normalized cosine pairwise distance followed by Spearman correlation
residual_definition: total perturbation response minus fold-specific mean response fitted on complete frozen outer-train sources
classification_rule: SUPPORTED requires near-absent geometry plus at least two compression signals; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED covers meaningful but incomplete geometry with at least two compression signals; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED.
strict_rules: Each geometry is computed only within one independently fitted model's held-out group
Primary bootstrap unit is perturbation source
No scGPT file or process access
